<p align="center"><strong>Discovery - what grows inside the pumpkins.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">The seed packets bear names instead of plant varieties. Ada Bell. Thomas Reed. Nell Wren. Every sowing date is October 31.</p>

<p align="center">Ada's packet contains a tiny paper witch hat. It matches one of the costumes you followed into the trees.</p>

<p align="center">On the drawer bottom, Elias has scratched: &quot;Their bodies went home empty. Their names are still here.&quot;</p>
